title: Rasgulla
description: Rasgulla is a India dish made with whole cow milk, lemon juice, semolina flour. This home-scale recipe assigns measured ingredients to the steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Heat milk almost to a boil, add lemon juice to separate curds, then strain through clean cheesecloth; rinse and squeeze carefully.
Roll or press the prepared dough evenly into the desired thickness and shape.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Prepare a light sugar syrup separately; it must be at a gentle boil before adding the cheese balls.
Simmer the kneaded cheese balls in sugar syrup with space to expand; they should become spongy and double in size.
Cool the prepared ingredients promptly, then refrigerate for about 90 minutes until properly chilled.
